questions.question: Four friends—Akash, Bhanu, Chintu, and Deepak—are standing in a straight line facing north. Bhanu is standing immediately to the right of Akash. Chintu is standing at one of the ends. Deepak is standing next to Chintu but not next to Akash. Who is standing at the second position from the left?

options.explanation: Akash is in the first position, not the second.
Bhanu is immediately to the right of Akash, placing him in the second position.
Chintu is at one of the ends, not the second position.
Deepak is in the third position, not the second.

questions.explanation: Given the constraints: Bhanu is immediately to the right of Akash, so the order starts with Akash, Bhanu, .... Chintu is at one end, so Chintu must be at the far left or far right. Deepak is next to Chintu but not next to Akash. If Chintu is at the far left, Deepak would be next to him, but then Deepak would also be next to Akash (since Akash is second), which violates the condition. Thus, Chintu must be at the far right. The order is: Akash (1st), Bhanu (2nd), Deepak (3rd), Chintu (4th).
questions.hint: Start by placing Chintu at one end and work through the constraints.

questions.question: A train travels from Station A to Station B at a speed of 60 km/h and returns from Station B to Station A at a speed of 40 km/h. What is the average speed of the train for the entire journey?

options.explanation: This is the arithmetic mean of the two speeds, not the correct average speed for the journey.
This is the correct average speed calculated using the harmonic mean formula for equal distances.
This is not supported by the calculations.
This is not supported by the calculations.

questions.explanation: Let the distance between A and B be D km. Time to travel from A to B = D/60 hours. Time to travel from B to A = D/40 hours. Total distance = 2D km. Total time = D/60 + D/40 = (2D + 3D)/120 = 5D/120 = D/24 hours. Average speed = Total distance / Total time = 2D / (D/24) = 48 km/h.
questions.hint: Use the formula for average speed when distances are equal: (2 * speed1 * speed2) / (speed1 + speed2).
